  path={"/management/fleets"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindAll handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve fleet records with optional filtering and pagination.
It supports filtering by either "correlation_id" or "team_id" query parameters, but not both simultaneously.
If both filters are provided, it returns a 400 Bad Request error.
Pagination is controlled via "page" and "page_size" query parameters, with defaults and limits applied.
Returns a JSON response containing the paginated fleets or an error message.
